summary: Remote event discovery is well-scoped and read-only. The 16 tests pass, but byte-exact immutability checking and additional negative-case tests are needed before approval.
issues: Hash raw Git blob bytes rather than text-mode output so Windows newline normalization cannot hide content changes.
Add integration tests for malformed remote events, group_id mismatches, and conflicting contents for the same event ID.
Move the unittest main guard to the end of tests/test_groupctl.py so direct execution includes RemoteEventTests.
tests_run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v: 16 tests passed
